# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We as members, contributors, and leaders pledge to make participation in the
a11y-toolkit community a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of
age, body size, visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex
characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience,
education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race,
religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

Accessibility is our subject matter — our community should model it.

## Our standards

Behaviors that contribute to a positive environment include: using welcoming
and inclusive language, being kind to others, writing and reviewing with
empathy, gracefully accepting constructive criticism, and focusing on what is
best for the community and for the disabled users this tool ultimately serves.

Unacceptable behavior includes: sexualized language, trolling, insulting or
derogatory comments, personal or political attacks, public or private
harassment, publishing others' private information, or other conduct which
could reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional setting.

## Enforcement

Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior may be
reported to the project maintainer via [GitHub contact](https://github.com/kinti)
or through [jquin.net](https://jquin.net/). All complaints will be reviewed and
addressed promptly and fairly. The maintainer is responsible for clarifying
and enforcing these standards and may remove, edit, or reject contributions
that violate this Code of Conduct.

Adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org),
version 2.1.
